provenance: explicit project-owner instruction in the Codex v0.1 release-candidate task
approval_scope: Visual approval of the exact frozen canonical fidelity-v2 delivery bound by the artifact manifest; not scientific, Science Day use, public-release, or GitHub publication approval.
known_limitations: The draw.io file is structurally editable but its official CLI render currently shows major colored regions as black and displays equations as raw LaTeX.
PPTX equations are independent vector objects rather than semantically editable Office Math, and its arrows are not attached connectors.
The PDF is a one-page preview/export and uses lossy encoding for embedded raster content.
Automated checks do not establish scientific correctness.
